content.text: I've compared each record item against the key and the transcript, checking the corrected figures ($15,000 pledge not $12,000; $32,388 not $35,388), the owner reassignment on the parish info, and the revised projection date.

key_items.note: Record 1 matches: Maisie Jane, August 27, 2026. Omits that she is son Nathan and Jess's daughter, but nothing wrong. No owner/date required for a life event.
Record 2 matches: Everett, right knee replacement, November 17, 2026. Drops the recovery detail (1-2 nights, six weeks PT, no driving for a month) but the date and side are right.
Record 3 has the corrected $15,000 (not the initial $12,000) out of Everett's rollover IRA payable to Saint Fintan Parish. Does not note that it counts toward his 2026 RMD, but no figure is wrong.

Record 4 carries the corrected remainder $32,388 (not the earlier $35,388) from Everett's rollover IRA. Omits the first-week-of-December timing and the 50% federal withholding (~$16,200), but states no incorrect figure.
Record 5 matches the final $70,000 conversion from Lorraine's traditional IRA to Roth (not the initial $17,000 discussed mid-meeting). Omits the December timing and zero federal/state withholding.

Record 6 matches: ~$40,000 of appreciated (Kettleby) stock from the joint brokerage to the new Stadtler Family Fund at Carrow Valley Community Foundation. Does not name Kettleby or the ~540 whole shares, but the $40,000 figure is the agreed one and no figure is wrong.

Record 7 correctly reassigns this to Everett (it moved from Lorraine to Everett at 00:20:08 because he sees Deb at the finance council) and dates it Monday, 2026-10-19. Omits the acknowledgment-letter ask; no figures involved.
Record 8 matches: Joelle builds the QCD request and sends it via the e-signature portal Wednesday, 2026-10-21. Does not restate the $15,000/payee, but carries no wrong figure.

Record 10 matches: Tobias sends the full conversion projection to both clients and Hal Dettweiler, due the revised 2026-10-30 (not the originally floated 23rd, which was dropped for his conference week).

Record 9 matches: Joelle sends the DAF application and stock transfer letter, due Tuesday, 2026-10-20. Omits the Stadtler Family Fund name, Nathan/Claire as successor advisors and the ~$40,000 of Kettleby shares, but no figure is stated wrongly.

Record 11 matches: Lorraine calls Hal to book the meeting for the first half of November, due 2026-10-16 ('I'll call Hal tomorrow'). Omits the before-surgery rationale and the state-tax question, but owner and date are the final ones.

Not captured. No record item covers Joelle preparing the Roth conversion form (Lorraine, zero withholding) and the December RMD distribution form (Everett, 50% federal withholding) once Hal signs off, dated to process the first week of December and signed before the 17th. Record 8 is the QCD form and record 9 is the DAF/stock paperwork, both already paired elsewhere.
